intended_object: An intermediate functor PSh(CostructuredArrow yoneda A) ⥤ PSh(C), F ↦ (X ↦ Σ_{s ∈ A(X)} F(yX, s)). It is one step in building the equivalence Over A ≌ (CostructuredArrow yoneda A)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v (Kashiwara–Schapira, Lemma 1.4.12). This comes from the docstring, the `OverPresheafAux` namespace and the module documentation.
explanation: The definition sits in the namespace `OverPresheafAux`. The module documentation says this namespace holds the technical, sigma-type-based construction behind `overEquivPresheafCostructuredArrow`, and that "a user of this result should not need to interact with the actual construction". The functor only sends F to the presheaf `yonedaCollectionPresheaf A F`, built from the auxiliary type `YonedaCollection`. It is a step toward the inverse functor of the equivalence (that inverse also gets a map to A, so it lands in Over A). It is not a standard named notion in the literature. It is used only as an implementation step inside the proof of the equivalence, so it is a technical device rather than a mathematical object to compare against a textbook definition.
